A '''duel''' took place in the office of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] "Kameron Suldar"&mdash;who was actually [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Ivaar Workan]] in disguise&mdash;in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] was part of a campaign undertaken by the [[New Jedi Order]] to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] Coruscant from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who had infiltrated the planet. The Jedi planned a series of simultaneous attacks on Sith all across the world, and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] were tasked with going undercover as Senate pages and distracting Workan until the arrival of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Jedi Knights [[Doran Sarkin-Tainer]] and [[Seha Dorvald]].

However, Workan's security guard was not willing to let them into the High [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord's]] office, and Khai decided to secretly reveal her identity in order to ensure their entry. They were allowed to enter, but were quickly taken captive by Workan's three Sith guards. Khai and the young Skywalker, however, managed to keep Workan talking until the three other Jedi arrived. Khai and Ben Skywalker quickly killed the three guards while Workan engged in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] with Luke Skywalker. The Jedi were hoping to capture Workan alive, but Khai wanted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] all of the Tribe's remaining High Lords, as they were duty-bound to kill her since she had murdered High Lord [[Sarasu Taalon]]. Thus, she suggested that Workan was attempting to get to his desk and trip a detonator that would kill them all, causing Dorvald and the Grand Master to dive away while Khai, the young Skywalker, and Tainer opened fire on Workan with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. After six shots, Ben Skywalker killed Workan with a shot to the head.
